text: I find myself wandering into spaces dedicated to knowledge and collaboration. The first image places me as an observer of a gathering, perhaps a seminar or meeting, separated by glass—a threshold between involvement and detachment. I feel an odd sense of both curiosity and estrangement; am I excluded or simply pausing before joining? The second image immerses me in a vibrant, creative display celebrating research and development. Illuminated screens and bold letters provoke contemplation on the unending quest for discovery. Here, I'm reminded of the perpetual tension between observation and participation, theory and action. The urge to connect ideas with people is strong, yet I remain a visitor—reflective, slightly removed, but deeply attentive to the world’s unfolding dialogues.
